gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Brio's 500 Series (CLBL520SC, Bob Vila's best overall) and its Moderna bottom-loaders (CLBL720SC/CLBL730SC, the 'upgrade' and 'premium' picks) are one ENERGY STAR certification at 0.76 kWh/day (about 277 kWh, or about $50 a year at EIA's 18.2¢/kWh for 2026), so the Moderna premium buys looks, not efficiency. They also don't state that ENERGY STAR's certified list has no Avalon model, which includes ChatGPT's 'best value' Avalon A4.
standout_why: I compared this against Bob Vila (the only cited page, updated 2026-01-28). It has no price for any pick, gives only a '$14 to $325' range, and reports no cooling times, temperatures or energy use. It mentions only a general claim that ENERGY STAR coolers use about 30% less energy. None of ChatGPT's cards gave a running cost or ENERGY STAR status. I did not open the uncited results (shouldit, Popular Mechanics, mybest and others), so I can't rule out that they state ENERGY STAR status. Their titles and snippets show no energy-cost table.
decides: This confirms the Avalon A4 at $179.99 (Target) as the cheapest way to get a three-temperature bottom-loader, but it has no ENERGY STAR record. It also changes the Brio advice. The Brio 500 costs $329.99 at Brio's own store, while Target sells a Brio Moderna Self-Cleaning bottom-loader in black for $280.99. Both are covered by the same 0.76 kWh/day certification, so the 'premium' Moderna is $49 cheaper than the 'best overall' 500 Series if you buy it at Target. One catch: Target's listing doesn't give a model number. The Moderna 730 bottom-loader costs $529.99 at Brio, which is $200 more than the 500 Series for the same certified energy use. For bottleless, Brio's 300 Series (CLPOU320) at $174.99 from Brio certifies at 0.56 kWh/day, about $13 a year less to run than the 500 Series, and costs $25 less than the $199.99 Avalon bottleless card.

findings.label: Bob Vila pick list, prices and test data
findings.value: 9 picks. Brio 500 Series CLBL520SC is best overall, Avalon A4 A4BLWTRCLR is best value, Primo Deluxe 900130-C is best design, Avalon A12 is best countertop, Brio Moderna 730 is the upgrade. No per-model prices, no energy or temperature measurements, and only 4 of the 9 were tested.
findings.source_title: The Best Water Coolers of 2026, Tested and Reviewed (Bob Vila)
findings.note: Drawbacks Bob Vila lists: Brio 500 needs 8 in. of space behind it, Avalon A4's drip tray can overflow, Primo Deluxe is noisy, Moderna is pricier, Primo hTRIO has no room-temperature water.
